CustomField.description: Percentage of an org limit at which the Chat feature becomes Degraded. Blank uses Org Limit Degraded Percent. Must be below the paused percentage; a value that is not is replaced by the paused percentage minus one.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Blank uses Org Limit Degraded Percent. Must be lower than Chat Paused Percent.
CustomField.label: Chat Degraded Percent
